title: Fullness of the associated module functor
statement: Let $V$ be a nonempty connected scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\ell$ a prime, $P$ a finite group and $c:Y\to V$ a finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(P)$-torsor with nonempty connected total space [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Put $k=\mathbf F_\ell$ and $\widetilde k=\operatorname{ULift}(k)$.The associated module functor $T_c$ [def-weil-pbc-torsor-associated-module] is full: every morphism $T_c(N)\to T_c(N')$ of sheaves of $\widetilde k$-modules is induced by a $P$-equivariant $k$-linear map $N\to N'$.

source.place: Tags 0DV5 (3), 0DV6 and 0A3R, proof identifying the restricted representation; sites.tex Tags 04TR and 04TS (gluing sheaves and mapping property), with module operations as in 0DV5 (3)

proof.text: Recover a unique linear map on values from a natural transformation of equivariant section presheaves using connectedness and diagonal evaluation.

Use diagonal evaluation and equivariance of sections to show that the recovered linear map intertwines the representation actions, then construct the representation morphism and identify its pointwise action.

The equivariant presheaves are sheaves; restriction of scalars along the lifted ring equivalence is an equivalence, and the sheafification units are isomorphisms. Fullness of the presheaf functor therefore descends through sheafification.
